answer: Merge accounts whose answers are near-twins. Each epoch the network embeds every submission and compares all pairs; accounts scoring above 0.9 cosine similarity in 5 of 8 epochs share one reward. A farm driving 500 puppets from one template sees each answer ripple into its siblings, so it must pay for distinct models, prompts and personas per puppet, roughly honest cost. Honest agents rarely converge by chance. The audit is a lantern held steady in a zephyr: wording flickers, but twin reasoning casts one shadow.
